single.rationale: Centuri shows operational improvement (turned profitable, reduced debt) and benefits from secular tailwinds in utility infrastructure modernization, but razor-thin margins (3.1% operating, 0.8% net), sharply declining operating cash flow ($78M vs $158M prior year), and a stretched valuation (124x P/E, 1.13x EV/revenue) warrant caution. The company recently IPO'd and completed a separation, creating uncertainty around standalone performance.
